underlines.text: having forced him to say what gave no one any pain but herself

reference.text: He was resolutely silent, however; and, from a determination of making him speak, she continued,—

underlines.text: his house, his fruit, of everything but himself

reference.text: There was now employment for the whole party; for though they could not all talk, they could all eat; and the beautiful pyramids of grapes, nectarines, and peaches, soon collected them round the table.
